descriptionChirho: Duration without end; everlastingness, used adverbially (often with preposition lamed) to mean 'forever, perpetually, in perpetuity'.
The quality of enduring or persisting; strength, confidence, or hope that lasts, often with pronominal suffixes indicating personal reliance.
Splendor or preeminence, used as a divine epithet ('the Glory of Israel') denoting God's unchanging majesty.
The final point or conclusion of something; the end or finishing of a matter.
Successful outcome in battle or contest; victory or triumph, often in doxological contexts ascribing victory to God.
